name: Player reference instruction
placementTarget: Not placed on the board. It tells you where the Build Satellite Tower and Transmit strips go.
text:
Place this sticker on the back of
each player reference card.

mechanics.timing: When the package is opened, before the new actions are used.
mechanics.effect: Instruction to stick the new action strips on the back of each player reference card.
restrictions: The asset list counts 2 copies of this instruction. The Build Satellite Tower strip and the Transmit strip are each a single image.
